title: Everything is Plausible: Investigating the Impact of LLM Rationales on Human Notions of Plausibility

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing human plausibility ratings of commonsense reasoning multiple-choice answers before and after exposure to LLM-generated PRO (supporting) and CON (opposing) rationales to measure how systematically human judgments are swayed by AI explanations.

Performing Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression on the collected plausibility data to determine if an individual's initial plausibility rating without a rationale strongly anchors their final rating, analyzing how the magnitude of rating changes correlates with initial baseline judgments.
